title: Phaser
tagline: Simple web3 dungeon game using Dynamic, PayPal and Opensea MCP.
description:
Phaser is a dungeon game where you can navigate to different rooms and talk to AI npcs. you can also buy potions to gain advantage in the game using paypal usd. the goal is to showcase how gaming will use nfts and crypto without knowing its web3. 

the project uses paypal usd for purchases, Dynamic for wallet connection and email wallet creation, and opensea's SDK to be able to check user's nfts in their wallets and chat with other NPC's and their wallets.
